description: 极细梳齿刷头根根分明，都会蓝天感的纤长眼妆套图

styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless studio field #FFFFFF for packshots, open clear sky #A9C7E0 over brushed metal for the low-angle benefit and rooftop shots, matte lilac panel #E9DCE4 and matte shell panel #F2E7E4 for comparison grids, unlit charcoal #2A2E33 for macro, flat rose #C48B93 for the icon screen
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright even high-key key light from the upper left with a soft fill card, controlled speculars on metal, thin contact shadows only, warm low sun with cool sky fill on the single rooftop shot, small catchlight on every eye macro
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte graphic panels, weathered concrete parapet and brushed metal rail; no fabric, no water, no clutter
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif grid kept as clean empty copy blocks; no source slogan, no rendered sentences, no shade names
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-weight continuous outline glyphs in #FFFFFF above empty rounded label plates
styleLock.presentationRules: one stable slim upright scale for the tube, the applicator always reads as the thinnest element in frame, identical crop and focal length inside every comparison or variant grid
noDrift: no redesign of the product silhouette or applicator
no identifiable face, likeness or signature
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent urban rooftop clean-beauty visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless studio field #FFFFFF, clear sky blue #A9C7E0, rose copper #C48B93 and ink charcoal #2A2E33, with matte lilac #E9DCE4 and matte shell #F2E7E4 as graphic panel neutrals; cool neutral daylight balanced by one warm rim source on the lifestyle screen; bright even high-key key light from the upper left with a soft fill card, controlled speculars on metal, thin contact shadows only; modern geometric sans-serif grid held as clean empty copy blocks; thin single-weight outline icon style; stable slim upright product scale and consistent straight-on or slight 3/4 read across the set; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，用管体与抽出的极细刷杆同框立住根根分明的心智。
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, tube closed and standing upright, full product visible with even headroom
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio light from the upper left with a soft fill card on the shadow side, thin contact shadow
shots.whitespace: generous even margin on all four sides, no copy zone reserved
shots.promptTemplate: Product packshot of {product}, the slim tube standing closed and upright at the centre of frame with its cap and applicator drawn out and placed beside it. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on eye-level camera, full product visible, nothing clipped. Bright even high-key studio light from the upper left with a soft fill card on the shadow side, controlled specular on the metal collar, a thin clean contact shadow grounding both pieces. Seamless studio field #FFFFFF. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame with generous even margins on all four sides and no copy zone reserved. Negative: no brand wordmark, no embossed or printed packaging lettering, no readable text, no watermark, no hands, no props, no background gradient, no floating product, no cropped cap or base.

shots.intent: 一秒讲清纤长主张，用仰拍让管体与刷杆像细长塔一样拔高。
shots.camera: very low angle looking upward, both pieces leaning against a rail on the left third
shots.lighting: cool open-sky daylight with a warm bounce off the metal, crisp specular edges, no harsh cast shadow
shots.background: clear sky blue #A9C7E0 with a fine haze near the horizon
shots.props: one brushed metal rail crossing the lower frame
shots.whitespace: clean empty sky block held on the right 40% for copy
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product} with its cap and applicator drawn out, both pieces leaning at a slight tilt against a brushed metal rail. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a very low angle looking upward so the two pieces read like slender towers on the left third of frame. Cool open-sky daylight with a warm bounce off the metal, crisp specular edges and no harsh cast shadow. Background clear sky blue #A9C7E0 with a fine haze near the horizon. The product occupies 50-60% of the frame, with a clean empty sky block held on the right 40% for copy. Negative: no rendered words or headlines, no brand mark, no packaging lettering, no named city landmark, no lens flare artefacts, no duplicated applicator, no plastic-looking metal, no warped straight lines.

shots.intent: 用三行裸睫与刷后的等格对照，让不同睫毛条件的买家各自对号入座。
shots.camera: straight-on frontal eye-level, three stacked rows of matched panel pairs, identical crop throughout
shots.lighting: soft directional daylight from the upper left, natural skin texture, small catchlight, no beauty-filter smoothing
shots.background: matte lilac panel #E9DCE4 with one solid tone band along the left edge of each row
shots.whitespace: narrow even gutters between rows, no copy zone reserved
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point grid of {product} answering three different lash conditions, laid out as three stacked rows of matched panel pairs. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on frontal eye-level camera with the framing, focal length and crop identical on every panel; only the lash state changes between the left and the right side of each row, from bare and sparse to cleanly combed and lengthened. Soft directional daylight from the upper left, natural skin texture with visible pores, a small catchlight, no beauty-filter smoothing. Background matte lilac panel #E9DCE4 with one solid tone band along the left edge of each row. The eye regions together occupy 40-50% of the frame with narrow even gutters between rows. Negative: no identifiable face, nose or full portrait, no readable row labels, no brand mark, no watermark, no retouched plastic skin, no false eyelash strips, no invented statistics, no mismatched crop between panels.

shots.intent: 用同机位同光的上下双格，把根根分明的效果差直接摆在眼前。
shots.camera: straight-on extreme close-up macro, two matched stacked panels with identical framing
shots.lighting: skimming soft light from the upper left separating individual lashes, gentle catchlight, no hard shadow
shots.background: matte shell panel #F2E7E4 with a solid rose #C48B93 plate along one edge
shots.whitespace: minimal, the detail fills the panels
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro before-and-after comparison for {product}, two matched stacked panels of a single eye region with identical framing, focal length and light. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on macro camera, tight zoom on the lash line, shallow depth of field with the outer lash tips sharp and the surrounding skin falling softly out of focus. Skimming soft light from the upper left that separates every individual lash, a gentle catchlight and no hard shadow. Background matte shell panel #F2E7E4 with a solid rose #C48B93 plate along one edge. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame with minimal whitespace since the detail is the subject. Negative: no distorted eyeball, no asymmetric or mismatched panels, no fabricated results, no false eyelash strips, no readable words, no brand mark, no watermark, no blurry foreground subject, no identifiable full face.

shots.intent: 把极细刷杆的梳齿结构拍成机制证据，解释为何能根根分明。
shots.camera: side profile camera at a slight low angle, tight zoom on the applicator spine set diagonally
shots.lighting: sweeping rim light from behind-left outlining each bristle plus a soft fill on the front face
shots.whitespace: negative space kept clear at the lower right
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of the tapered applicator wand of {product}, set diagonally across the frame so the full spine of densely flocked teeth stays in focus. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Side profile camera at a slight low angle, tight zoom on the brush spine, shallow depth of field. Sweeping rim light from behind left that outlines every bristle, with a soft fill on the front face and a controlled specular on the metal collar. Background unlit deep charcoal #2A2E33. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame with negative space kept clear at the lower right. Negative: no visible hand or fingers, no human face, no blurred core detail, no duplicated or melted bristle rows, no readable numbers, no brand mark, no watermark, no product floating without support.

shots.intent: 用一条竖向膏体试色证明配方轻薄成膜、拉开不结块。

shots.lighting: even diffused high-key light from above, soft sheen travelling along the ridges, no cast shadow
shots.whitespace: wide clean margins on both sides of the stroke
shots.promptTemplate: Top-down flat lay swatch screen for {product}: one thick glossy stroke of the formula pulled straight down the centre of a seamless field so the combed fibres read as fine parallel streaks. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle, tight zoom on the stroke texture. Even diffused high-key light from above with a soft sheen travelling along the ridges and no cast shadow beyond a faint edge. Seamless studio field #FFFFFF. The swatch occupies 55-60% of the frame with wide clean margins on both sides. Negative: no smear outside the swatch, no fingerprints, no dust or lint, no cracked dry texture, no unrealistic pigment shift, no readable words, no brand mark, no watermark, no duplicated stroke.

shots.intent: 把产品放进都会天台日落氛围里，让买家投射自己的上妆时刻。

Background matte lilac panel #E9DCE4 with tinted tiles in deep charcoal #2A2E33, rose copper #C48B93 and pale shell #F2E7E4. shots.intent: 收口降风险，用空白标签牌与线描图标承载可替换的信任主张。
shots.camera: flat straight-on camera facing the graphic panel head-on, no perspective tilt
shots.lighting: even diffused flat light with a subtle top sheen, no shadow falling from the glyphs
shots.background: dusty rose #C48B93 fading softly toward the corners
shots.whitespace: generous even margins around the grid, no extra whitespace reserved
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust screen for {product}: a clean grid of thin single-weight line glyphs on a rose field, each glyph drawn in one continuous outline above an empty rounded label plate kept deliberately blank. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Flat straight-on camera facing the graphic panel head-on with no perspective tilt, the whole grid square to the lens. Even diffused flat light with a subtle top sheen so the field stays calm and no shadow falls from the glyphs. Background dusty rose #C48B93 fading softly toward the corners. The glyph grid occupies 50-60% of the frame with generous even margins and no extra whitespace reserved. Negative: do not invent certifications, lab results, test claims, awards or ratings; no authority badges, no seals, no readable words, no signature, no brand mark, no watermark, no multi-weight or cluttered linework.

provenance.notes: 9 张源图逐图事实：001 白底管体与抽出的极细刷杆并立；002 白底单条竖向膏体拉丝试色；003 单眼上下双格裸睫与刷后对照、左缘色带标签；004 仰拍管体与刷杆倚靠金属栏杆、开阔天空背景配三段利益点文字；005 三行裸睫与刷后等格对照、左缘睫毛条件标签；006 刷杆斜置大特写叠虚化天际线与标题文字；007 多格眼妆色号拼图配色带与色名；008 代言人半身逆光肖像加手写签名与身份头衔；009 玫瑰底六枚白色线描图标加检测类标签。品类判定：源为着彩类眼部彩妆（睫毛膏），非护理或工具，故归 美妆彩妆/眼妆；本款以极细梳齿刷杆与根根分明的对照/刷头机制分镜为核心语义，与库内既有曲线瓶身纤维刷款在 leaf 与 slug 上均不同义。已剥离：品牌字标与系列名、代言人姓名/肖像/签名、管身浮雕与印刷字母、全部原文案原句、时长与根数与色号数等数值断言、抗晕与检测类功效主张、平台角标与店铺字样；源类目挂法仅作假设未采信。人物一律改写为无身份可辨识的眼部特写或颈部以下裁切，产品全部以 {product} 占位，图内文案位改为空白留白块与空白标签牌。
